entries.heading: AUTHORIZATION
ancestors: DIVISION C—DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY NATIONAL SECURITY AUTHORIZATIONS AND OTHER AUTHORIZATIONS
TITLE XXXII—DEFENSE NUCLEAR FACILITIES SAFETY BOARD
entries.text:
SEC. 3201. AUTHORIZATION.

    There are authorized to be appropriated for fiscal year 2021, 
$28,836,000 for the operation of the Defense Nuclear Facilities Safety 
Board under chapter 21 of the Atomic Energy Act of 1954 (42 U.S.C. 2286 
et seq.).
